genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. Quantoz Payments B.V. holds Dutch EMI authorization R186418, effective 2023-10-13. No public GENIUS issuer approval, official application, foreign registration or applicable Treasury comparability determination was located in the sources checked. No U.S. issuer pathway or supervising U.S. regulator is inferred from the Dutch license. The issuer CEO's June 2025 discussion of GENIUS does not announce a Quantoz application or a specific authorization route. Issuer-authorization rules remain proposals. Treasury's September 30 SCRC interim final rule concerns procedures and does not qualify Quantoz or accelerate the Act's effective date; Treasury's August proposal gives an expected general effective date of 2027-01-18 and the general DASP offer/sale restriction date of 2028-07-18. The foreign-issuer lawful-order condition would apply when the Act becomes effective. Reserve disclosure is present: the current issuer snapshot was published 2026-08-30. This self-reported snapshot and an ISAE 3402 Type 2 controls description do not establish a publicly available monthly independent reserve-attestation series. Token terms sections 24-27 provide face-value redemption, KYC/AML checks, EEA/UK/Swiss address and bank-account restrictions, and non-registered-holder access; recovery/redemption-plan clauses permit limitations. No public enforcement action was identified in the bounded sources checked; this is not a comprehensive clearance. Reserve-report date recorded as of 2026-08-14 review: 2026-06-30 (date kind unspecified).

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, the public regulatory materials and issuer disclosures checked did not identify Quantoz Payments B.V. as a GENIUS permitted issuer, state-qualified issuer, official applicant or registered foreign issuer, or identify a Treasury comparability determination applicable to it. The OCC pending digital-asset applications table and NYDFS regulated-entities list did not name Quantoz. These lists have limited scope; absence does not establish prohibition or rule out non-public filings. The Dutch EMI authorization does not establish U.S. authorization. FinCEN's published index, OFAC's 2026 index and the public enforcement search did not identify a named Quantoz action.
